categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Kelun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. operates primarily in pharmaceutical manufacturing, focusing on large-volume injections (infusions), small-volume injections, sterile powders for injection, tablets, capsules, granules, oral liquids, peritoneal dialysis solutions, antibiotic intermediates, APIs, and pharmaceutical packaging materials. The company also engages in pharmaceutical R&D, production, and sales, covering therapeutic areas such as oncology, anti-infection, parenteral nutrition, liquid therapy, central nervous system, cardiovascular, anesthesia and analgesia, respiratory, osteoporosis, men's health, diabetes, and rheumatoid arthritis.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including high-end infusion production with multi-chamber bags, biopharmaceutical fermentation, synthetic biology, and antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) development. It has established national innovation platforms such as the National Large-volume Injection Engineering Technology Research Center and the National Engineering Research Center for Targeted Biopharmaceuticals. Production adheres strictly to GMP standards, with intelligent manufacturing upgrades and AI integration in fermentation and R&D processes to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kelun Pharma serves a broad range of customers including hospitals, distributors, and downstream manufacturers. Its products target clinical end-users in hospitals and healthcare institutions across multiple therapeutic areas. The company also exports to over 50 countries and regions, serving international pharmaceutical markets. Key customers include major healthcare providers and pharmaceutical distributors in China and abroad.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with subsidiaries and production bases in multiple provinces including Sichuan, Hunan, Henan, Guangxi, Guizhou, and others. It also has international operations and investments in Hong Kong, the United States, Kazakhstan, Sri Lanka, and other countries. Its products are sold domestically and exported globally, with significant presence in Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sichuan Kelun Pharmaceutical operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing drug R&D, manufacturing of APIs, intermediates, and finished dosage forms, as well as pharmaceutical packaging and distribution. It controls the full production cycle from raw material fermentation and synthesis to finished product manufacturing and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven growth through the 'three-driver' strategy emphasizing high-end generics, improved innovative drugs, and original innovation. It invests heavily in R&D, particularly in ADCs, synthetic biology, and complex formulations. The company pursues international collaborations, AI-enabled drug discovery and manufacturing, and aims to expand its innovative oncology and immunotherapy pipelines. It also focuses on cost leadership, production efficiency, and expanding market access through national procurement and insurance inclusion.
categories.revenue_model: Kelun Pharma generates revenue primarily through product sales of pharmaceutical formulations, APIs, and intermediates. It also earns licensing income from overseas partnerships, especially in innovative drug development. The company’s sales channels include direct sales, agency sales, and exports. Revenue is derived from domestic hospital sales, government procurement programs, and international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kelun Pharma is one of the largest and most comprehensive pharmaceutical groups in China, ranked among the top 100 Chinese pharmaceutical manufacturers and top 500 manufacturing enterprises. It holds a leading position in the infusion market and biopharmaceutical fermentation globally. The company competes with other major Chinese pharmaceutical firms and multinational corporations in generics, innovative drugs, and biopharmaceuticals, leveraging its strong R&D capabilities and broad product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 21.8 billion, a 1.67% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.94 billion, up 19.53%. Total assets reached RMB 37.3 billion, with net assets of RMB 22.48 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by increased sales in antibiotic intermediates, overseas licensing income, and optimized product mix despite pricing pressures from national procurement.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kelun Pharma emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio, technological innovation, and quality leadership, particularly in infusion products with patented multi-chamber bag technology (e.g., Keli® bags). It offers high safety and environmental benefits with proprietary technologies, holding numerous patents and national awards. The company’s R&D strength in ADCs and synthetic biology provides differentiated innovative oncology therapies. Its integrated supply chain and intelligent manufacturing enable cost competitiveness and reliable supply, supporting its market leadership and brand reputation.
